_about: Alias -> groups, hand-edited. Lookup is on the folded alias (lower case, letters and digits). Each id must be a group the page can open; 'name' is the group's name when written (a rename is reported at build, as for hand placements). Order = order shown. fit 'good' or 'partial'; a partial alias must say in 'note' what it leaves out, and the page shows that note on the row. Prefer stable ids (hand:, kw:, rp:, tag:); leaf:/tent:/loose: ids are hashes and can change between builds (about 34 of 1,273 leaf ids did): the build counts them and reports any alias whose id vanished as an ERROR.
